questions.question: What did the prophet Azariah tell Asa?
options: Build a strong wall around the city
Make an alliance with a foreign king
March out to war against the north
The LORD is with you while you are with him
questions.answer: The LORD is with you while you are with him

questions.question: What did Asa and the people do in response?
options: Did nothing and ignored the word
Made a covenant to seek the LORD
questions.answer: Made a covenant to seek the LORD

questions.question: Asa removed his grandmother Maacah from being queen mother because of her idol.
Azariah said, 'If you seek him, he will be _____ by you.'
They sought the LORD with their whole desire, and he gave them _____ all around.
